Name: Costum Npc Base
Author: Kaffeesatz
Description:
Okay in the first place I´am bad at english so I hope that you can understand what i´m writing here.The Mod comes there-> SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\CustomNPC\NpcsThen open up and see all this tsv, json and jpg files for that jpg you need gimp or photoshop whatever you like to use with that you can edit the filethe tsv und json files can you simple edit with Notepad++ .So that is the start .... Editing : [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s5cEf7NLvJ6iIu6kh1oRGKE-Uw25Aak0xs2S5_MA9to/edit]Modding Guide[/url]﻿ maybe helps better then me ^^Portrait : Make a new Portrait or use some of the portrait mods there are out there .Remember to make them not to big or to small !You can see the size of them when you look at the portraits .Sprite : same as Portraits but when you try to make some new animations or whatever ,clothing and stuff, you need all"scenes" . I let the alex sprite as example in there . Look at the football sprite 
Animations : There you must edit what sprites are used in this animations . [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1607]Here[/url]﻿ in his description you can find anything about this but I try to make it easier (is that right ? ) 
[u]Animations:[/u]
key;<startFrameNr>/<framenr for repeat> <framenr for repeat> <framenr for repeat> ... /<endFrameNr>
my Example : alex_football; 16/17....17/16 
so that is alex_football <-- is the name of the animation don´t forget the ; and then you have the number of the sprite you will use for the animation 
first number is the start sprite then / to start the animation . every number between the / is the animation you will see also all the sprites after another 
in repeat . After the / comes the endsprite the last sprite to end the animation .

little break ? yea me too ! :) okay next ?
[u]Dialogues:[/u]
key;value
easy -> alex_say, "bla bla i´m alex !"
you can use in this talking portraits too for this look at he modding guide 

[u]Schedules:[/u]
key;command;command;command;...
also that means first is like weather or season or day also like
rain; 800 (time) JoshHouse(map)  21 4 2 (first number is from left to right side bigger , second from above to down bigger , last number the way he look 0 above 1 right 2 down 3 left ) and then your animation name like alex_football then comes / and the endtime for the animation or the action whatever 
example : rain;800 JoshHouse 21 4 2 alex_football/1200 JoshHouse 16 3 2/1600 JoshHouse .....

OMG that is it i´am done well done ... okay hope that helps .
I go and drink a tea 
Have fun
